infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Pranora needs your location to find nearby verified veterinary clinics, emergency animal rescue, and pet services.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Pranora requires camera access so you can photograph injured animals for rescue, document pet medical records, and take profile photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pranora needs access to your photo library to upload pet photos, vaccination cards, and medical prescriptions.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Pranora requires microphone access for the AI voice assistant push-to-talk feature.
